notes: INSIDE half of the drone_bay_mk3 (neon line, 3x3): the hangar pit with its launch rail, the cradle (EMPTY here: the game draws the loaded drone on it while docked, and an empty cradle while it is out), parts racks and a status strip. fire = launch 0-3 (the cradle runs up the rail), out = re-arming. anchors.cradle is the cradle pivot in frame px at rest; cradle_launch_up the px it has risen per launch frame.
